_doc: A blast that takes a limb (Pwalkers-13, 16): a force 5 blow 9 m east of the busiest crowd of the town (a limb can go from 120.7 kPa, some 11 m off; death begins at some 7 m: blast.json), the clock running; four seconds on, the body nearest it (setViewNear body) near (90 px a metre) from 210 degrees at 35 and from above: somebody maimed lies there down for good, the limb gone, bleeding, the limb thrown clear; the shoot_test's census says who; then 1500 frames on, bled out where they lay, the body kept. By day.
